question: Which river from the following flows through a rift valley?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tapi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tapi river:-**

 
 
• **The river that flows through a rift valley is the Tapi river.**
 
• The Tapi river originates in the Satpura range in Madhya Pradesh and flows through Maharashtra and Gujarat before emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
• The rift valley through which the Tapi river flows is known as the Tapi Valley or the Narmada-Tapi rift zone.
 
• The Tapi Valley is a geological formation that was created due to tectonic movements in the earth's crust.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmaputra: **

 
 
• The Brahmaputra river flows through the northeastern part of India and into Bangladesh. 
 
 
 
• **Sabarmati: **
 
 
• The Sabarmati river flows through Gujarat and empties into the Arabian Sea. 
 
 
 
• **Ganga: **
 
 
• The Ganga river is one of the major rivers of India and flows through several states.
